speaker: Sheldon
text: It's not enough that you made me watch that movie, and now you mock me with it. Gentlemen, I have a question about dating and relationships.

speaker: Sheldon
text: More to the point, it's about finding a way to keep Leonard and Stephanie together. Why not?

speaker: Howard
text: I've been waiting for someone to have the talk with me. Oh, I don't think you can. Look at Leonard's record. 27 days with Joyce Kim.

speaker: Raj
text: You told me you were gonna have the talk with him. During which he defected to North Korea.

speaker: Howard
text: Two booty calls with Leslie Winkle.

speaker: Raj
text: For which she awarded him the nickname Speed of Light Leonard.

speaker: Howard
text: And a three-hour dinner with Penny.

speaker: Raj
text: Which would have been two and a half if they ordered the soufflé when they sat down.

speaker: Howard
text: Based on the geometric progression, his relationship with Stephanie should have ended after 20 minutes.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Yes, I'm aware of the math. Y equals 27 days over 12 to the nth. The issue remains. How do we circumvent his inevitable rejection?

speaker: Raj
text: Well, if you want to guarantee his appeal to Stephanie, your best bet would be to kill all the other men on the planet.

speaker: Howard
text: I'll tell you what you shouldn't do. Don't spritz him with that body spray from the commercial where the women undress when they smell it. That doesn't work at all.
